title: Billed Hours Utilization Project Concentration
dataSources: Invoices (`freelance:invoice`), billed hours (`freelance:hours`), tax estimates (`freelance:tax`), client pipeline records (`freelance:lead`), project health (`freelance:project`).
app: Freelance invoices, billed-hours exports, quarterly tax estimates, and client-pipeline updates streamed to Splunk HEC via accounting APIs, spreadsheets, and CRM forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=freelance:hours
| stats sum(hours_billed) as amount count as records by project
| eventstats sum(amount) as total_amount
| eval pct_of_total=round(100*amount/total_amount,1)
| sort - pct_of_total
description: Shows how concentrated billed hours utilization value is in each project bucket.
value: Concentration risk matters in personal businesses because too much dependence on one project can make a quiet month painful.
implementation: Use stable group labels such as client segment, quarter, or service line for consistent trending.
visualization: Treemap or bar chart of amount share by project.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights whether too much of billed hours utilization depends on one project bucket.
